qualification.education_qualification: Masters/Hons in Indian History/Anthropology/Arts, Diploma in Library Science, Degree/Diploma in Modelling/Sculpture
qualification.details: Library and Information Officer: Masters or equivalent Hon's Degree in Indian History or Anthropology or Arts; Diploma in Library Science; 7 Years experience in a Library preferably Museum Library; Research experience with published work in Archaeology or Art or Anthropology. Head Modeller: Degree or Diploma in Modelling sculpture from a recognised University or Institute; About 5 years experience in a responsible position of working on sculpture models and allied works. Hindi Translator: Graduate or equivalent degree in Hindi in addition to English; At least 5 years experience in Translation work in any big establishment. Modeller: School Final or equivalent; Degree or Diploma of a recognised Art College in Arts with specialization in modelling; At least 3 years practical experience in modelling. Driver-cum-Mechanic: Class 10th pass; Professional skill in driving with thorough knowledge of Car mechanism and permanent Motor driving license; 5 years practical experience in driving and minor repairs.

content_sections.heading: Indian Museum Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Library and Information Officer, 1 for Head Modeller, 1 for Hindi Translator, 1 for Modeller and 1 for Driver-cum-Mechanic.

content_sections.heading: Indian Museum Kolkata Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Library and Information Officer: Masters or equivalent Hon's Degree in Indian History or Anthropology or Arts; Diploma in Library Science; 7 Years experience in a Library preferably Museum Library; Research experience with published work in Archaeology or Art or Anthropology. Head Modeller: Degree or Diploma in Modelling sculpture from a recognised University or Institute; About 5 years experience in a responsible position of working on sculpture models and allied works. Hindi Translator: Graduate or equivalent degree in Hindi in addition to English; At least 5 years experience in Translation work in any big establishment. Modeller: School Final or equivalent; Degree or Diploma of a recognised Art College in Arts with specialization in modelling; At least 3 years practical experience in modelling. Driver-cum-Mechanic: Class 10th pass; Professional skill in driving with thorough knowledge of Car mechanism and permanent Motor driving license; 5 years practical experience in driving and minor repairs.

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Indian Museum Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Indian Museum Kolkata Recruitment 2026 is 23rd October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for various posts including Library and Information Officer, Head Modeller, Hindi Translator, Modeller, and Driver-cum-Mechanic.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, ranging from Class 10th pass to Masters degrees in relevant fields, along with specific experience requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 - 81,100) to Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - 112,400) per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Indian Museum Kolkata Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application with all required documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test, followed by a Skill Test, and finally the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article or directly from the Indian Museum Kolkata's official website.
